_why: One pinned REFERENCE GUEST per parity dimension. A cell measured on a guest
that cannot exercise its dimension produces an ambiguous zero that reads as
agreement; this file makes that structurally impossible instead of a thing
each agent must remember. Twice a dimension was measured on a guest that
POPULATED OUTPUT IS NOT A VALID CONTROL, and the numbers below prove it:
/bin/true emits 31 [stack] hashes yet its [stack] mapping never grows (1
distinct range, span 0), and it had 0/31 cross-backend agreement. Every one
of the four guests here emits nonzero [heap] AND [stack] records, so
'count > 0' cannot discriminate an exercising guest from a bystander. The
discriminator is IDENTITY (source sha256) plus a per-dimension WITNESS.

_measured.note: Guests must NOT live under /tmp: hermit replaces guest /tmp and refuses with an explicit error.
_measured.corroboration: heap_fragment_reuse reproduced 24 ptrace heap hashes and heap-sum=6358, independently matching task kvm-heap-parity-fails-differing-hash-counts-and-sequences.

stdout.why: Writes 257 deterministic self-generated lines. /bin/true writes ZERO bytes, so a stdout comparison over it compares two empty strings and passes vacuously.
disqualifies: a guest that writes no stdout of its own

detlog.why: Drives 32 iterations of clock_gettime/getpid/dup/close, all determinized by Detcore, so the INFO record stream has guest-caused records to align. /bin/true's records are loader traffic no guest code caused.
disqualifies: a guest whose records are dominated by process setup

stack.why: 4096 frames of size-varying recursion (8..1032B) grow the [stack] mapping from 0x21000 to 0x209000 -- MEASURED 2 distinct ranges. /bin/true emits 31 stack hashes over 1 static range: populated, never exercised.
disqualifies: /bin/true and any guest whose [stack] mapping never grows, however many hashes it emits

heap.why: malloc/fragment/reuse: 64 x 8KiB, free every other, realloc at 2x. Recovered byte-exact from the run that produced the first real heap-parity measurement; its recorded binary sha256 cde91b38... also matched.
disqualifies: /bin/true, which yields 0 heap records -- an ambiguous 0/0 that must never render green

not_comparable.reason: the ptrace reference does not control this instruction, so a cross-backend number here compares two uncontrolled paths
not_comparable.mechanism: interception under ptrace requires a KERNEL FAULT CONTROL for the instruction (PR_SET_TSC/CR4.TSD for RDTSC, CPUID-faulting for CPUID); the kernel exposes NONE for RDRAND/RDSEED -- 52 prctl options and 24 CR4 bits checked, zero matches. RDRAND-exiting is a VMX/SVM control, hypervisor-only.
not_comparable.evidence: ptrace n=6: rdrand 6/6 distinct, rdseed 6/6 distinct, while cpuid and rdtsc were 1/6 distinct in the SAME runs; 4/4 distinct under --strict
not_comparable.self_determinism_still_valid: a SINGLE backend's self-determinism on this axis IS measurable and is not blocked by this marking; only comparison against the ptrace reference is refused
not_comparable.consequence: a backend that CORRECTLY determinizes RDRAND would score as DIVERGING from the reference, so publishing a number here would penalise the fix

rdrand.why: RDRAND is executed directly by the guest. Hermit masks its CPUID feature bit, but the mask is ADVISORY -- the instruction does not fault, so ptrace has no trap point.
disqualifies: any cross-backend RDRAND parity value measured against ptrace

_not_comparable_rule: A dimension carrying `not_comparable` is REFUSED at emission with the literal string NOT-COMPARABLE plus its reason -- matching the form used by compat-envelope/self_determinism_gate.py. An explicit NOT-COMPARABLE is a REAL result; a blank or a green is a false one. Refusing with 'unknown dimension' would be a blank, which is why these two are DECLARED rather than merely absent.
